fact.subject: OpenAI
fact.object: GPT-6 Cyber and Daybreak Red access

evidence.quote: We’re introducing GPT‑6 Cyber, a major leap in security research: more capable at finding and fixing vulnerabilities, and far more reliable staying within the boundaries researchers set.
On ExploitGym, which tests whether models can exploit a specified vulnerability, GPT‑6 Cyber scores 48.5%, up from 32.1% for GPT‑5.6 Cyber.
GPT‑6 Cyber is initially available through the API and Codex to a select group of approved Daybreak Red customers.

title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
displayTitle: OpenAI推出GPT‑6 Cyber：攻防能力跃升，但仅向获批团队开放
summary: OpenAI推出面向授权安全研究的GPT‑6 Cyber，官方称ExploitGym达到48.5%，高于上一代的32.1%；初期仅向少数获批Daybreak Red客户开放API和Codex接入。
investorNote: 安全模型的能力跃升与访问边界同步成为产品设计问题，自测数字不能直接外推到开放网络。
narrative: OpenAI发布GPT‑6 Cyber，自述在ExploitGym上达到48.5%，对照GPT‑5.6 Cyber的32.1%；初期仅向少数获批Daybreak Red客户开放。投资视角的重点不只是漏洞发现率，还有授权范围控制和审计能力能否跟上模型能力。

eventRelation.reason: 新发布的安全模型与授权使用安排，非历史Daybreak数据政策的重述。
